name: Establish External Provider Session
summary: Moves a resolved active durable identity with valid OAuth proof and established home context into normal authenticated session capability.

sourceState.expression: durable-identity == resolved and account-status == active and home-workspace == established and credential-proof == oauth-proved and session-capability != authenticated-normal
